scientific_integrity: The configuration-model SIR branching spectral-radius formula is established prior theory. This result is the constrained integer contact-degree design classification, not a new general epidemic reproduction formula.
scientific_limitations: Equal-sized classes, class-regular positive integer degrees, fixed integer mean contact degree, asymptotic locally tree-like uncorrelated configuration model
Independent per-edge infection with recipient-dependent transmissibility and single infection/removal (SIR), not SIS
Finite-network outcomes, mixing patterns, dynamic contacts and real-world reconfiguration costs not analyzed
Related earlier work supplies general reproduction formula; historical-priority claim remains provisional.
title: Exact contact-degree allocation thresholds for two susceptibility classes in a configuration-model SIR epidemic
